title: triage scope_summary.modules records '- + `path`' new-file bullets as a bare '+' (path lost)
detail: Repro: design/deferred-tier-destination/scope.md (2026-10-25) lists new files as '- + `prusik/deferred_tier.py` — …' — the dash-then-plus form the scoping role spec explicitly accepts ('Either bullet form is accepted'). prusik gate scope validates it, but decisions/deferred-tier-destination.json scope_summary.modules contains two literal '+' entries in place of prusik/deferred_tier.py and tests/test_deferred_tier.py. Two parsers of the same Modules-touched section disagree: the scope validator handles the marker, the triage summarizer does not. Downstream consumers of scope_summary.modules (triage reasoning, plan cross-refs, HQ exports) see phantom '+' modules and miss the new files. Suggest: one shared Modules-touched parser used by both, moat-tested on both bullet forms.
